description: Find MCP servers by product name, publisher, or topic. Ranked by relevance (exact name, then publisher, then tags and description); the product's own server comes first when there is one (jira finds Atlassian's), duplicates merged. Returns compact cards with trust signals; call get_install next. When the user describes a job rather than a product, recommend_servers is one call instead of two.

category.description: Category slug: developer-tools, design-tools, databases, browser-automation, web-scraping, cloud-infrastructure, devops, productivity, communication, knowledge-memory, search, finance, security, data-science-ml, marketing, e-commerce, content-management, collaboration, analytics-monitoring, voice-agents, telephony, speech, autonomous-agents, project-management, documentation, game-development, mobile-development, social-media. list_categories has counts.

client.description: Only servers that work in this client (chatgpt keeps remote servers only). With fields=[install], adds the snippet for it.

fields.description: Extra card fields. install (needs client) and tools_count need a PlugMCP key.

limit.description: Results per page. Default 8. Without a key at most 10.

official_only.description: Only servers published by the product they connect to.

query.description: Product, publisher, or topic, for example github, postgres, send email. Empty lists the most used servers.

remote_only.description: Only hosted servers with a remote URL, no local install.

response_format.description: json (default) or markdown for a human-readable text block. structuredContent is always JSON.

verified_only.description: Only servers that passed the live health check.

voice_ready.description: Only servers suited to voice agents.

name: search_servers

official.description: Published by the product it connects to.

total_capped.description: True when there are more than 1000 matches.

title: Search MCP servers
